summary_for_children: Al-Fil means The Elephant. It tells how Allah protected the House when an army with an elephant came, sending flocks of birds with stones of baked clay.
environment_concept: A dusty road to Makkah where a great army with an elephant comes, birds in flocks gather over the hills, and the army becomes like eaten straw; the House stands untouched.
architecture_and_scenery: Desert road, an elephant, hills, a sky of birds, a field of straw.

palette.lighting: Hot sun, then a sky darkened by flocks

areas.name: The Army Road
areas.description: A road with an elephant's tracks.

areas.name: Stones of Clay
areas.description: Small clay stones on the ground.

activities.name: Put the ayahs in order
activities.description: Arrange the surah's five ayahs in the order they come. The cards show the verified Arabic and translation; this is a reading game.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the four places of this world to the ayah each one comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Leader names and details come from tafsir, not the surah, and are marked as such. No person is shown and no violence is depicted.

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own desert scene (elephant and tracks, flocks over the hills, clay stones, a field of eaten straw) and two playable activities
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 1280x800; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene, place cards and both activities

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
